issues: hook doesn't lead to the lesson: hook and cards are the Great Image (go in and rest at dusk), the lesson is the Tuan's shape (the strong goes below the weak)
side image: the hexagram's centre is 隨時, following the time
finding lacks reason (shape only)

lesson.text:
Follow the hour,
not your wants.
lesson.basis: Tuan 天下隨時，隨時之義大矣哉 (all under heaven follows the time; great is the meaning of following the time). Wang Bi on line 1: 隨不以欲，以欲隨宜 (he follows not from desire; he bends desire to what fits). Great Image 君子以嚮晦入宴息 (at dusk the noble one goes in and rests).

finding.text:
AT THE BASE: THE POST CHANGES.
FOLLOW WHAT FITS, NOT WANTS.
finding.basis: Line 1 官有渝 (the post changes); Small Image 從正吉也 (following what is right is good); Wang Bi 隨不以欲，以欲隨宜 (follows not from desire but by what fits).

shorts.note: 'To be followed, follow first' is a sound Tuan reading but it answers a leadership question the hook never asks. Following the time, not desire, is the hexagram's centre and answers 'still at your desk after dark'.

issues: surface-only: names the act (clean it out) but not the stance
misses the hexagram's reason: five lines repair what the father left, and the Small Images say the aim is to carry it on (意承考, 承以德)

lesson.text:
Clean out the rot,
keep what was good.
lesson.basis: Line 1 Small Image 幹父之蠱，意承考也 (setting right the father's spoiled work: the aim is to carry on from him). Line 5 幹父用譽，承以德也 (carries it on through virtue). Line 4 裕父之蠱，往未得也 (letting the rot slide gets nowhere). Fits the animation: the worms pour out, the bowl stays.

shorts.note: Repair in 蠱 is loyal, not a purge: you fix what those before you left so their work can go on. The judgment's 先甲三日，後甲三日 (three days before, three days after) is the plain basis for the card rewrite.

issues: surface-only: 'care for your people' is an outward act with no reason
hook doesn't lead to the lesson: cards are about autumn coming, lesson is about people

lesson.text:
Lean down, and
trust your people.
lesson.basis: Line 5 知臨，大君之宜 (approaching with wisdom: what befits a great ruler); Wang Bi 委物以能而不犯焉，則聰明者竭其視聽 (he gives each task to the able and does not meddle, so the able give all they have). Great Image 容保民无疆 (embrace and protect the people without limit). Fits the animation: the eye leans down and the three squares light up.

shorts.note: When things take off, 臨 is about how the one above approaches those below: by real response (咸臨) and trust (知臨), not sweet talk (甘臨, line 3). Trust gives the reason the growth can outlast the autumn in card 2.

issues: hook doesn't lead to the lesson: hook and cards say go and look, the lesson says you are watched
finding lacks reason (shape only)

lesson.text:
Go look at your people.
They show how you lead.
lesson.basis: Line 5 觀我生 (look at my own life); Small Image 觀民也 (that is, look at the people); Wang Bi 觀民之俗，以察己道 (observe the people's ways to examine your own way). Great Image 先王以省方觀民設教 (the former kings toured the regions and observed the people).

finding.text:
LINE 5: LOOK AT YOUR OWN LIFE.
BY LOOKING AT YOUR PEOPLE.
finding.basis: Line 5 觀我生，君子无咎 (look at my own life; the noble one is without blame); Small Image 觀我生，觀民也 (to look at my life is to look at the people). Line 5 is the master already marked.

shorts.note: 觀 means both looking and being looked at, and line 5 joins them: the ruler sees his own conduct in the people. This keeps the hook's 'go and see' and the current lesson's 'people watch you' in one line. The audit's line 4 (guest of the king) is a side image.

issues: hook doesn't lead to the lesson: the hook is a thing blocking you, 'warn' assumes a person
leaves out measure: lines 2 and 5 turn on biting as hard as the fault, no harder (得當)

lesson.text:
Be clear first,
then bite in measure.
lesson.basis: Tuan 動而明 (act, and be clear); Great Image 先王以明罰勑法 (make penalties clear and set the law in order); line 5 Small Image 貞厲无咎，得當也 (no blame, because it fits); line 2 Wang Bi 噬過其分，故滅鼻 (bites past its share, so the nose is lost).

promises.rewrite:
Don’t wait for it
to clear itself.

shorts.note: The current lesson is close; the hexagram's reason is clarity (明) and a bite that fits the fault. Line 1's 小懲大誡 (small punishment, great warning) backs 'warn first' if the user prefers to keep it.

issues: finding lacks reason: 'AT THE TOP: PLAIN WHITE.' gives the image only

finding.text:
AT THE TOP: PLAIN WHITE.
IT KEEPS TO WHAT IT IS.
finding.basis: Line 6 白賁，无咎 (plain white adornment, no blame); Wang Bi 飾終反素，故在其質素，不勞文飾 (at adornment's end it returns to plain: it keeps to its plain substance and does not toil at ornament).

shorts.note: Settled with the user; the lesson holds. The finding is the one rule from 10 it misses, so the reason line is offered as an option only.

issues: lesson restates card 2 ('help those below you') without the reason
reason missing: the top is secure only because the base carries it

lesson.text:
Shore up the base.
The top rests on it.
lesson.basis: Great Image 山附於地，剝。上以厚下安宅 (the mountain rests on the earth: those above make the base thick, and the house is secure). Line 6 Small Image 君子得輿，民所載也 (the noble one gets a carriage: the people carry him). Fits the animation: pieces fall until only the base stands.

shorts.note: In 剝 the lines strip the bed from the feet up; the one strong line at the top survives only by what is under it. The reason makes 'shore up the base' more than an act.

issues: hook doesn't quite lead to the lesson: hook is after a long bad stretch, lesson says 'early'
reason left out: the Small Image gives 以脩身也 (to mend the self), the lesson stops at the act

lesson.text:
Turn back early,
and mend yourself.
lesson.basis: Line 1 不遠復，无祗悔，元吉 (returning from not far, no great regret); Small Image 不遠之復，以脩身也 (returning from not far is how one mends oneself); Wang Bi 幾悔而反，以此脩身，患難遠矣 (he turns back at the first sign of regret, and by this mends himself).

shorts.note: The source already names 以脩身; the lesson just needs to say it. Option instead: change the hook to fit 'early' (e.g. a first slip), since line 3 頻復 (returning again and again) is the line for a long bad stretch.

issues: finding lacks reason (shape only)
meaning 2 promises a result

finding.text:
LINE 2: PLOW, NOT FOR CROPS.
IT IS NOT AFTER GAIN.
finding.basis: Line 2 不耕穫 (read with Cheng Yi and Zhu Xi as working without counting on the harvest); Small Image 不耕穫，未富也 (not for riches); Wang Bi 不擅其美，乃盡臣道 (he does not claim the credit; that is the full way of one who serves). Wang Bi reads the image as reaping what another began; his reason (not for his own gain) still supports the second line.

promises.rewrite:
Stop faking.
Mean what you do.

shorts.note: 'Do what's right, not what pays' names the motive, which is the centre of 无妄: action without scheming. The finding option leans on the later reading of line 2's image, so the user may prefer the plain shape finding with no line.

issues: surface-only: 'store up, then use' is a sequence of acts with no reason
finding lacks reason (shape only)

lesson.text:
Train, then go out
when the time is right.
lesson.basis: Line 3 曰閑輿衛，利有攸往 (drill the chariot and guard daily; it pays to set out); Wang Bi 進得其時 (he advances at the right time) and 畜極則通 (stored to the full, it breaks through). Great Image 君子以多識前言往行，以畜其德 (learns the words and deeds of the past to store up virtue).

finding.text:
LINE 3: DRILL, THEN RIDE OUT.
IT GOES AT THE RIGHT TIME.
finding.basis: Line 3 良馬逐…曰閑輿衛，利有攸往 (good horses race; drill the chariot daily; it pays to set out); Wang Bi 進得其時，雖涉艱難而无患也 (advancing at its time, it crosses hardship without harm).

shorts.note: Lines 1 and 2 are held back (有厲利已, 輿說輹) and line 3 goes when storing is full; timing is the reason the text gives. The audit's line 3 is right; this adds the reason line from Wang Bi.

issues: surface-only: guard your mouth is the Great Image's act
lesson repeats meaning 1 and 2
misses the reason: 頤 is about what you nourish (養正則吉)

lesson.text:
Guard your mouth.
Feed what is right.
lesson.basis: Great Image 君子以慎言語，節飲食 (careful in speech, moderate in food and drink). Tuan 頤，貞吉，養正則吉也。觀頤，觀其所養也 (nourishing what is right is good; look at the jaws to see what one nourishes). Line 1 Wang Bi 守道則福至，求祿則辱來 (keep the way and good comes; chase reward and disgrace comes).

shorts.note: The judgment and Tuan say you can see a person by what they feed themselves and others; care with food and words is how that shows. The lesson should name what the guarding serves.

issues: surface-only: 'brace them now' is an act
misses the reason the lines give: the rigid line 3 holds only its own place and sags, lines 2 and 4 lend strength to the weak

lesson.text:
Don't just hold it.
Prop up what's weak.
lesson.basis: Tuan 棟橈，本末弱也 (the ridgepole sags: root and tip are weak). Line 3 Small Image 棟橈之凶，不可以有輔也 (the sagging ridgepole cannot be helped); Wang Bi 自守所居，不能救危拯弱 (holds only its own place, cannot rescue the weak). Line 2 Wang Bi 能過其本而救其弱 (goes past its own place to rescue the weak).

shorts.note: The hook's viewer is the overloaded middle; line 3 shows the strong one that only holds its place and breaks, and lines 2 and 4 share strength with the weak ends. That is the reason behind bracing.

issues: wrong reading, partly: 信 in the Tuan is water staying true to its course, 'keep your word' reads as a promise to others
hook doesn't lead to the lesson: one problem after another, answered with promise-keeping

lesson.basis: Judgment 有孚，維心亨 (with trust, only the heart gets through); Tuan 水流而不盈，行險而不失其信 (water flows and does not pile up; through danger it does not lose its trust) and 維心亨，乃以剛中也 (the heart gets through by the firmness at its centre).

shorts.note: The two strong centre lines are the point: danger outside, firm within, and water keeps flowing. Close to 10's 'steady inside', so the user may want different words.

issues: hook doesn't lead to the lesson: burnout is answered with an abstract 'cling to what is right'
side reading: misses line 4, the blaze that comes, burns, dies and is cast off

lesson.text:
Fire lives on what
it clings to. Choose well.
lesson.basis: Tuan 離，麗也。日月麗乎天，百穀草木麗乎土 (Li is clinging: sun and moon cling to the sky, grain and plants to the soil) and 柔麗乎中正，故亨 (the yielding clings to the central and correct, so it goes through). Line 4 突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如 (it comes suddenly, blazes, dies, is cast off); Wang Bi 欲進其盛 (it pushes its blaze).

shorts.note: Fire has no body of its own and lasts only by what it holds to; line 4 is burnout from forcing the blaze. The reason (fire lives on what it clings to) links the hook, 'keep it fed', and the Tuan.

issues: finding lacks reason (shape only)

finding.text:
ALL THREE PAIRS ANSWER.
EACH MOVES AND IS MOVED.
finding.basis: Tuan 柔上而剛下，二氣感應以相與 (the soft above, the firm below; the two move and answer each other and join). Shape finding kept, so no LINE prefix; line 4 (the heart) was the only single-line option and it carries a different lesson.

shorts.note: 'Be moved as you move others' is the Tuan's 感應相與 and 男下女 (the man goes below the woman), and the cards carry the Great Image 以虛受人 (receives others by being empty). The hook, cards and lesson hold together.

issues: lesson text lacks a closing period ('keep your course')
shorts.note: Change shape, keep your course is the Tuan's 四時變化而能久成 (the seasons change and so endure) with the Great Image 立不易方 (stands and does not change direction), and fits the moon animation. If the hook needs a closer link, the Tuan's 終則有始 (each end has a beginning) speaks to 'starting over'.
